page.overview:
What is Argyr's Realmsry?

Argyr's Realmsry was a general store and large warehouse in the village of Dawngleam in Cormyr in the 14 century DR.

This shop carried all manner of goods, imported from the cities of Marsember and Suzail at the order of customers who put down half the price as a deposit. The shop was aided in its intercity acquisitions by agents of the Cormyrean crown, who had an avid interest in ensuring that Dawngleam was on track to develop into a full city.

Some of the daily oddities that it carried included food (such as cheeses), wine, clothes, nails, tools, ropes, furniture, candles, and even the secondhand gowns and gloves of nobles.

Circa 1366 DR, the shop's proprietor, Austas Argyr, spent over a season sending letters to the prominent business woman Aurora. He hoped to convince her to make Argyr's Realmsry into an outlet of the Aurora's Emporium, for he feared that Aurora might be planning to open an outlet in Dawngleam that would compete with his shop. However, Austas would receive no reply from Aurora within that time. His concern drove Austas to diligently provide his customers the best service possible.
